label: Products of powers of x with exponentials
section: Products of powers of $x$ with $e^{ax}$, $\sin x$, and $\cos x$
subgoals: Set u=x^n, dv=e^(ax)dx to lower the degree by one
Evaluate integral of x^3e^x as e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)

label: Powers of sine and cosine
subgoals: Split sin^n via cos^2=1-sin^2 to rejoin the family
Anchor at S_0=x and S_1=-cos x
Evaluate integral of sin^4x to -sin^3x cos x/4-3sin x cos x/8+3x/8

label: Recurrences for definite integrals
subgoals: Drop the boundary term -sin^(n-1)x cos x/n on [0,pi/2]
Iterate (n-1)/n down to base cases pi/2 and 1
Evaluate integral of sin^4x over [0,pi/2] as 3pi/16
